summary: National Healthcare Properties filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting the closing of the first tranche of its previously announced sale of an 86-property outpatient medical facility portfolio to an unaffiliated third-party buyer under a May 4, 2026 purchase agreement, as amended. The first tranche comprises 30 properties, generating roughly $79 million in net cash proceeds before transaction expenses, prorations, and adjustments. Concurrently, the company repaid about $119 million of secured debt, including $60 million encumbering other OMFs outside the portfolio. No advisor or board recommendation was disclosed; remaining tranches and deleveraging progress are the key risk-arb watch items.
